caveats: Fully synthetic CPU brute-force scans; no real embeddings, GPU, database or ANN index
15 distinct seed/distribution cases repeated over 3 hosts; only 15 independent synthetic datasets
End-to-end timings start after vectors and queries are quantized; quantization cost logged separately
No controlled CPU clock/power or thermal profiling; medians from one run per seed and host
Candidate selection is topM int8 brute force for each M, then original float32 rescoring
